meta_data.base_class: Check whether a particular game is currently on sale in a <video game platform> store - refers to a dedicated gaming hardware platform such as PlayStation or Xbox that has its own game distribution and pricing system.

tool_template.name: check_<class>_game_on_sale
tool_template.description: Checks if a particular game is currently on sale in a <class> store.

game_title.description: The title of the video game.

region.description: The region to check for the <class> store.

currency.description: The currency in which the sale price should be displayed for the <class> store.

include_discount_percentage.description: Whether or not to include the discount percentage information when checking the sale status in the <class> store.

check_additional_content.description: Whether to check if additional content or DLC for the game is also on sale in the <class> store.

edition_type.description: Optional field to specify the edition of the game if applicable (e.g., 'standard', 'deluxe'). Ignored for platforms that do not distinguish editions.
